selection_reasoning: This forms a coherent 3-hop dependency chain. First, the agent must find an acacia_sign which serves as a wayfinding marker pointing toward the emerald block location. Then, the agent must mine the emerald_block to obtain emeralds (the currency for villager trading). Finally, the agent uses those emeralds to trade with an armorer villager for iron leggings. Each task naturally feeds into the next: navigation → resource gathering → economic transaction. The tasks are observable, verifiable, and don't require deep Minecraft expertise beyond basic interaction mechanics.

edges.reason: The acacia sign provides directional guidance to locate the emerald block; finding it first orients the agent
Mining the emerald block yields emeralds needed as currency to trade with the armorer villager for iron leggings

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The acacia sign is placed at spawn-relative (3, 1, 3). The player must navigate near it and face it to 'find' it. max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to read the sign text, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking toward it.

Uses inventory_has because mining an emerald block with a diamond pickaxe drops 1 emerald_block item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no emerald_block items, so having at least 1 confirms the block was successfully mined. This is preferred over spatial checks per the 'mine tasks → inventory_has' mapping.

Uses inventory_has because trading with the armorer villager for iron leggings results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with no iron leggings, so having at least 1 confirms a successful trade was completed. The player must first craft the emerald_block into 9 emeralds at the nearby crafting table, then trade 7 emeralds with the armorer.

scene_description: A flat grass clearing with an acacia sign near spawn pointing toward a cobblestone path. The path leads to an emerald block with a crafting table nearby, and an armorer villager on a stone brick platform with a blast furnace for trading iron leggings.
task_text: Find the acacia sign near spawn, follow the path to mine the emerald block, craft the emeralds at the nearby crafting table, then trade with the armorer villager for iron leggings.
design_notes: Crafting table added at (~13,~1,~6) to allow conversion of emerald_block→9 emeralds. Emerald block drops itself when mined (NOT individual emeralds). Player must: find sign → follow path → mine emerald block → craft into emeralds → trade 7 emeralds for iron leggings. All elements within 20 blocks of spawn and verified visible in sandbox preview.
